title: Web Foundations (Example)
tagline: A small example course showing the import format
description: This example shows how to write a Beyownd course: modules, lessons in Markdown files, a YouTube video lesson, a quiz per module and a final project with a rubric.

rubric.criterion: Deployed and works on a phone

modules.title: How the Web Works
modules.description: Requests, responses and the structure of a page.

lessons.title: CSS in 20 minutes (video)
lessons.content: Watch the video, then style the page you made in the previous lesson.

questions.prompt: What does the browser send to a server to load a page?
questions.explanation: The browser sends an HTTP request; the server replies with a response.

questions.prompt: Which language describes the *structure* of a page?
questions.explanation: HTML is structure, CSS is style, JavaScript is behaviour.

questions.prompt: Which of these are HTML tags? (select all)
Which keyword declares a variable that cannot be reassigned?

questions.explanation: The template literal inserts the value of `name`.

questions.prompt: Which are primitive types in JavaScript? (select all)
questions.explanation: Arrays and objects are not primitives.
